label: Casual leave
q: How many days of casual leave can I take?

texts.leave_2022:
Ref: POL-3
Eastgate College Attendance Policy. Issued 2022-06-01.
Students may take up to 10 days of casual leave per semester without a medical certificate.
texts.leave_2025:
Ref: POL-9
Eastgate College Attendance Policy, revised. Issued 2025-01-10. This policy supersedes POL-3.
Students may take up to 6 days of casual leave per semester without a medical certificate.

label: Tuition refund
q: How many days do I have to withdraw for a full tuition refund?

texts.refund_2023:
Ref: FEE-2
Eastgate College Fee Refund Rules. Effective 2023-04-01.
A student who withdraws within 30 days of the semester start receives a full tuition refund.
texts.refund_2026:
Ref: FEE-5
Eastgate College Fee Refund Rules. Effective 2026-03-01.
A student who withdraws within 14 days of the semester start receives a full tuition refund.

verdicts.reason: refund_2026 is the later version of the same document

label: Library fines
q: What is the overdue charge for library books?

texts.library_2024:
Ref: LIB-1
Eastgate College Library Rules. Issued 2024-02-01.
Overdue books cost 2 rupees per day after a 3 day grace period. Reference books cannot be issued.
texts.library_2026:
Ref: LIB-4
Eastgate College Library Rules, amendment. Issued 2026-05-05.
In the Library Rules, the overdue charge is changed to 5 rupees per day. All other rules stay as they are.

verdicts.reason: library_2026 amends library_2024 and the rest of it stays

label: Hostel gates
q: What time do hostel gates close?

texts.hostel_a:
Eastgate College Hostel Rules.
Hostel gates close at 9 pm on weekdays for first year students.
texts.hostel_b:
Eastgate College Hostel Notice.
Hostel gates close at 10 pm on weekdays for first year students.

verdicts.reason: no dates and no clear sign of which came first

label: Lab safety
q: What do I need to wear in the chemistry lab?

texts.lab_2025:
Ref: LAB-1
Eastgate College Chemistry Lab Safety. Issued 2025-08-01.
Goggles and closed shoes are required in the chemistry lab at all times.
